{{Top|leg}}
The '''melding''' was an intimate procedure practiced by the [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzans]] in which there was a sharing of the same mind. This process was aided by the use of an [[Attanni]]&mdash;a device that linked the thoughts of two individuals [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]].
